training_timing_notice: Packed model metadata inherits its first component timing; aggregate costs here sum every component model timing. Zero cross-block parameters increase packed storage/compute and are not independently trained.

confirmation_summary.selection_rule: positive own-baseline gain at main budget, no caused all-off/on, no primary device mean loss over tolerance; largest gain among L1/L2_max/L2_smooth
confirmation_summary.notice: Previously inspected development household, ideal simulated answers; seeds are not independent households. No final H1/H2/H3 or power improvement claim.

structure_gain.notice: Source state head/features only; excluded from confirmation gain.

acceptance_rule.notice: Saved before R1 fixed-query simulation/evaluation. Repeatability requires positive primary-device mean own-baseline gain in at least 6 of the 9 fixed source/query seed pairs in every development household. This is a development gate, not independent-household evidence or statistical significance. Final H1 still requires at least 3 final households, mean gain 0.05 and at least two thirds of final households positive.

unsure_semantics: Offline oracle returns unsure only for incomplete label support; it imposes no minimum complete-event duration. These are not reports of user unwillingness or measured recall errors.
limits: One new inspected development household; historical House 3 has PV limitations.
